changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: DuckDB FK must be same schema — keep fact in dim schema, expose via fact schema view
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_fact_ohlcv ON dim.fact_market_ohlcv(instrument_id, date)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_fact_ohlcv_date ON dim.fact_market_ohlcv(date)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW fact.fact_market_ohlcv AS SELECT * FROM dim.fact_market_ohlcv

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Dedup ROW_NUMBER PARTITION BY symbol,date ORDER BY epoch DESC, then FK lookup. Idempotent.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO dim.fact_market_ohlcv SELECT d.instrument_id, CAST(y.date AS DATE), y.epoch, y.open, y.high, y.low, y.close, y.adj_close, y.volume, now(), year(CAST(y.date AS DATE)) FROM (SELECT * EXCLUDE rn FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol, date ORDER BY epoch DESC) AS rn FROM read_parquet('/media/sandeep/DataDrive2/hedge-fund/datalake/data/silver/market/ohlcv.parquet')) WHERE rn=1) y JOIN dim.dim_instrument d ON d.symbol=y.symbol

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_fact_macro ON dim.fact_macro_observations(indicator_id, country_iso3, date)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW fact.fact_macro_observations AS SELECT * FROM dim.fact_macro_observations

changeSet.author: hedge-fund
changeSet.comment: Map empty country_iso3 -> UNK to satisfy FK + NOT NULL (no data loss)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO dim.fact_macro_observations (indicator_id, country_iso3, date, year, value, obs_status, lastupdated) SELECT indicator_id, country_iso3_fixed, date, year, value, obs_status, CAST(lastupdated AS TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM (SELECT * EXCLUDE (rn) FROM (SELECT *, COALESCE(NULLIF(country_iso3,''),'UNK') AS country_iso3_fixed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY indicator_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(country_iso3,''),'UNK'), date ORDER BY lastupdated DESC) AS rn FROM read_parquet('/media/sandeep/DataDrive2/hedge-fund/datalake/data/silver/macro/observations.parquet')) WHERE rn=1)
